import numpy as np, math
x=np.array([0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1],float);L=np.array([0.1, 0.02, -0.01],float);T=500;d1=-0.4;err=np.array([0.001, 0.001, 0.001, 0.001, 0.001],float);kb=8.617333262145e-5

 ideal=0.0 if q==1 else kb*T*(q*math.log(q)+(1-q)*math.log(1-q));z=2*q-1;dg=q*d1+ideal+q*(1-q)*sum(L[k]*z**k for k in range(3));g.append([dg,err[i],0,0,0])
